cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/testbr.c <<'C'
#include <brotli/decode.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
int main(int argc,char**argv){FILE*f=fopen(argv[1],"rb");fseek(f,0,2);size_t n=ftell(f);fseek(f,0,0);unsigned char*in=malloc(n);fread(in,1,n,f);BrotliDecoderState*d=BrotliDecoderCreateInstance(0,0,0);size_t un=n*2,avail_in=n,avail_out,total=0;const unsigned char*next_in=in;unsigned char*arr=0,*next_out;BrotliDecoderResult r;int dos=0,iter=0;do{arr=realloc(arr,un);avail_out=un-total;next_out=arr+total;fprintf(stderr,"iter %d un=%zu total=%zu avail_out=%zu avail_in=%zu\n",iter++,un,total,avail_out,avail_in);r=BrotliDecoderDecompressStream(d,&avail_in,&next_in,&avail_out,&next_out,&total);fprintf(stderr," -> r=%d total=%zu avail_out=%zu avail_in=%zu\n",r,total,avail_out,avail_in);if(r==BROTLI_DECODER_RESULT_NEEDS_MORE_OUTPUT){un*=2;if(un>131072){if(++dos>1)break;un=131072;}}else if(r==BROTLI_DECODER_RESULT_NEEDS_MORE_INPUT)break;else if(r==BROTLI_DECODER_RESULT_ERROR){fprintf(stderr,"err %s\n",BrotliDecoderErrorString(BrotliDecoderGetErrorCode(d)));break;}}while(r!=BROTLI_DECODER_RESULT_SUCCESS);}
C


cc /tmp/testbr.c -lbrotlidec -o /tmp/testbr && /tmp/testbr /tmp/zeros.br
